name: App Tilt Hero
description: A dark product hero: a markup-drawn mail app tilted back 22° flattens as you scroll, while its sidebar, rows and draft stagger in and the counts tick up.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono line above the headline, after a small accent dot.

props.name: muted
props.description: Substring of the headline set at 45% ink; it lands as its own beat after the first part.

props.name: primary
props.description: White pill with a download glyph.

props.name: account
props.description: Signed-in user shown in the title bar.

props.name: folders
props.description: Sidebar folders. The first three are the triage buckets (the first is selected and heads the list); counts tick up from zero.

props.name: threads
props.type: { from; initials; subject; preview; time; unread?; drafted? }[]
props.description: Rows in the list; drafted rows get a Draft mark with an accent dot. Rows stagger in 45ms apart.

props.name: message
props.type: { subject; from; fromEmail; to; time; body: string[]; draft: string[]; attachment? }
props.description: The open thread and the reply Tern drafted for it.

props.name: overnight
props.description: Sidebar summary; its accent meter fills to done / triaged after the card lands.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Starting tilt in degrees; flattens to 0 as the window scrolls into place.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: things Tern prepared (eyebrow dot, Draft marks, draft label, overnight meter).

props.name: theme
props.description: Black stage or a daylight grey one with a white window.
